sdk: Pinned Vapi SDK from dependencies/source-lock.json; no upstream changes.
behavior: Three successful exact private API GET modes: active call, standalone chat and active chat session; the configured assistant must match.
Twelve wrong/missing resource or assistant responses produce no verification evidence.
Ended calls (including inconsistent active status with endedAt), completed sessions and session chats presented as standalone chats are denied.
401/403/404/429/500 private API failures produce a safe unavailable error and no automatic retry through the standard connector constructor.
Eighteen empty, oversized, Unicode or path/query/fragment/encoding identifier denials occur before any provider request.
VerifiedVapiOrigin has private fields and no Deserialize; the compile-fail doctest prevents JSON from constructing verification evidence.

review.responsibility: Provider transport remains in connect-connectors; the helper has no store, service, grant issuance or model tool dependency.
review.data_minimization: Proof keeps only mode, matched resource/assistant IDs and observation timestamp; error variants omit raw SDK/provider data.

limits: No numbered item or acceptance criterion closed.
This helper is not yet wired into protected resource creation, binding registration, grant issuance/export or the first provider tool request.
Observation is not a credential or cached current authority; task/grant checks and provider lifecycle revalidation remain required in composition.
Chat verification proves the exact standalone resource/assistant association; it does not infer an undocumented active-chat status.
No inline/squad assistant fallback. Missing saved-assistant IDs are denied.
Loopback SDK fixtures only; no live provider account read, resource mutation, model invocation or public ingress.

additional_research.sessions_update: Current reference lists name/status/expiration/messages as PATCH request fields; assistantOverrides appears in the response schema, so arbitrary MCP/tool mutation after session creation must not be assumed.
additional_research.chat_context: Current code already uses documented assistantOverrides.variableValues with a required connect_context prompt variable; the suspected model override mismatch was disproved by source inspection and no context code was changed.
